scripts.dev: bun run build:css && bunx ng serve
scripts.build: bun run build:css && bun scripts/sync-content.js && bunx ng build && bun scripts/generate-static-articles.js && bun scripts/validate-static-output.js
scripts.pages:deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=robson-cassiano-portfolio --branch=master
scripts.sandbox:build: mkdir -p sandbox/public/assets && cp -r src/assets/* sandbox/public/assets/ && cd sandbox && bun run build
scripts.sandbox:deploy: bun run sandbox:build && bunx wrangler pages deploy sandbox/dist --project-name=robson-cassiano-portfolio --branch=sandbox
